"""Wrapper for fine-tuning job — downloads data, runs script, uploads outputs."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys

import hopsworks

project = hopsworks.login()
dataset_api = project.get_dataset_api()

# Download input files to working directory
for fname in ["base_model.npz", "finetune.txt", "eval.txt", "finetune_model.py"]:
    dataset_api.download(
        f"Resources/jobs/ftjob30461d/{fname}",
        local_path=".",
        overwrite=True,
    )

# Run the fine-tuning script
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "finetune_model.py"], check=True)

# Upload outputs back to HopsFS
for fname in ["finetuned_model.npz", "metrics.json"]:
    dataset_api.upload(fname, "Resources/jobs/ftjob30461d/output", overwrite=True)

print("Fine-tuning complete. Outputs uploaded to HopsFS.")
